## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.20
**Fixed** - **Secure Archive** — updating or replacing an existing 7z or ZIP archive is now atomic, so an interrupted write can no longer leave you without both the old and the new file. Cancel also stops a running compression or extraction right away, and an extraction that fails or is cancelled no longer leaves a half-written folder behind. - **Per-app audio volume** — when a controlled app quits and reopens, the mixer now re-attaches to it instead of silently losing control of its volume. - **Scrolling** — reverse scrolling now goes the right way when Karabiner-Elements is driving the pointer. - **Active-window highlight** — changing the highlight color, glow, or thickness now takes effect immediately instead of waiting for the window to move. - **Built-in display** — restoring the built-in display after a mirroring change now confirms the screen actually came back before reporting success.
**Improved** - **Security & privacy** — software updates are now fetched over HTTPS only, the Finder-action helper ignores duplicate or replayed requests, the app's runtime hardening was tightened, and the automation permission description now accurately reflects every use.
